$comment: T-3.19. Cover choice tuning. Candidates are cover points within maxPathM of path; each is scored protection x weights.protection (the fraction of threats it hides the concealed body from) + weights.firing when a firing position exists, less weights.pathPerM per metre walked and weights.crowd per friend within crowdRadiusM. A high point's firing position is a side step of sideStepM either way along its face. A reservation is released once its holder, having come within arriveM, is more than leaveM from it, or dies.
